question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

A new arrow added in bottom of the existing arrow in each next figure and direction of the arrow is reversed from the previous one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eea0fa8a2eab324af9c9d9cea6507d922b25f18ea0ee3872324cec529581e12.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d940567d2bbcc1922fde4a166da419f0ba3e66dca0ea41fd8e5e0fd85dc0624.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
